title: Kent 2022 S-token secure region (beta_max vs theta)
caption: Game S2 only: Kent, Lowndes, Pitalua-Garcia, Rarity, npj Quantum Inf. 8, 28 (2022), Theorem 1 (eps_unf) with Lemmas 2-3, re-evaluated by qmint.proofs.finite_size following the paper's Fig. 5 procedure (N = 4e+07, each exponential term <= 1e-9/2, beta_PB = beta_PS = beta). Curves: largest admissible bias per misalignment theta for three error rates E; below a curve the hypothetical tuple is certified, above it UNCERTIFIED; where no beta is admissible the curve stops (no value is drawn, never zero). Stars: values quoted in the paper (DIGITIZED_FIGURE). X: the paper's experimental tuple (E = 0.058, theta = 10 deg) lies outside the Theorem 1 domain; lane D's independent checker returns UNCERTIFIED. This is NOT the Schiansky 2023 payment protocol (game D1) and no hybrid of the two proofs is drawn.
legend: [DIGITIZED] paper Fig. 5 values quoted in Methods
